confidence_notes: The July 2026 Zakopane price survey had nine contributors; its PLN food, coffee and beer prices are approximate in USD. Cocktail and wine prices are inferred relative to draft beer. Accommodation is a holistic estimate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Zakopane’s mountain-resort demand supports a modest premium over Krakow and Wroclaw for dorms and private hostel rooms, and a three-star estimate near Gdansk’s. Basic guesthouses remain plentiful, so their price is close to the Polish-city comparables.
